ui.orders.move.name: Move
ui.orders.move.desc: Left-click the destination. Hold ⇧ to append waypoints.
ui.orders.patrol.name: Patrol
ui.orders.patrol.desc: Waypoints with ⇧. Engineers reclaim, repair and assist on their own along the way.
ui.orders.assist.name: Assist / Guard
ui.orders.assist.desc: Target an own unit, construction site or factory: help or follow.
ui.orders.reclaim.name: Reclaim
ui.orders.reclaim.desc: Target a wreck, rock, tree or own structure. Left-drag reclaims an area.
ui.orders.repair.name: Repair
ui.orders.repair.desc: Target a damaged own unit or structure.
ui.orders.attack.name: Attack / Attack-move
ui.orders.attack.desc: On a unit: attack. On the ground: advance and engage everything on the way.
ui.orders.stop.name: Stop
ui.orders.stop.desc: Clears the order queue of the selection.
ui.orders.pause.name: Pause
ui.orders.pause.desc: Halts construction, production or upgrade; press again to resume.
ui.orders.fireState.name: Fire state
ui.orders.fireState.desc: Cycles through fire at will, return fire, hold fire.
ui.orders.ability.name: Toggle ability
ui.orders.ability.desc: Turns the selection's shield, radar or auto tap shot on or off.
ui.orders.attackGround.name: Attack ground
ui.orders.attackGround.desc: Artillery only: shells a point, even without vision.
ui.orders.tapshot.name: Tap shot (manual)
ui.orders.tapshot.desc: The Reeve taps its ember core: a heavy shot paid from stored energy.
ui.orders.formation.name: Formation
ui.orders.formation.desc: Choose a formation; right-drag draws a line.
ui.orders.selfDestruct.name: Self-destruct
ui.orders.selfDestruct.desc: Click or key combination only, never a grid key. 5 s countdown, press again to abort.
ui.orders.behavior.armed: Armed: left-click picks the target, ⇧ keeps it armed, Esc or right-click cancels
ui.orders.behavior.cycle: Cycle: every press selects the next mode
ui.orders.behavior.countdown: 5 s countdown, press again to abort
ui.orders.state.countdown: Detonating in {n} s – click again to abort
ui.orders.reason.noAbility: No unit with a toggleable ability
ui.orders.reason.nothingToPause: Nothing to pause (no construction, no production)
ui.orders.reason.factoryOnly: Factories do not accept this order
ui.orders.label: {name} ({keys})
